####################################################################################################
Purpose of script: To check the model results and compare them to climate 
####################################################################################################

```{r}
rm(list = ls())
source("../00_pck.R")
source("fun_ampphi.R")
theme_set(theme_classic() + theme(strip.background = element_blank()))
```

# Read nasapower data 
```{r}
all_nasapower <- pomp::bake(glue("{dirs$climfit}/all_nasapower.rds"), dir = "", {
  readRDS(glue("{dirs$processed}/03_stu_climate/stu_nasapower.rds")) %>%
    filter(week != 53) %>%
    mutate(pi_week = week * (2*pi/52),
           llid = str_replace_all(llid, " ", "_"))
})
```

# Plot some 
```{r}
all_nasapower %>%
  filter(clim == "clim_t2m", llid %in% unique(all_nasapower$llid)[1:160]) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = week, y = value_norm, color = paste0(lon,lat))) +
  geom_line() + 
  facet_wrap(study+country~.) + 
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

# Run 1 model for 1 llid
```{r}
if(FALSE) {
  length(unique(all_nasapower$llid))
  dat <- all_nasapower %>%
    filter(llid == unique(all_nasapower$llid)[1])
  
  mod_l <- sapply(unique(dat$clim)[1], function(x) {
    brm(value_norm ~ cos(pi_week) + sin(pi_week), data = filter(dat, clim == x))
  }, simplify = FALSE)
  
  # Check fit 
  filter(dat, clim == "clim_rh2m") %>%
    mutate(dat = "data") %>%
    bind_rows(filter(dat, clim == "clim_rh2m") %>%
                mutate(dat = "prediction",
                       value_norm = posterior_predict(mod_l[[1]], ndraws = 1)[1,])) %>%
    bind_rows(conditional_effects(mod_l[[1]], effects = c("pi_week"))$`pi_week` %>%
                mutate(value_norm = estimate__, dat = "mod")) %>% 
    ggplot(aes(x = pi_week, y = value_norm, color = dat, fill = dat)) + 
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lower__, ymax = upper__), alpha = 0.1, color = "transparent") + 
    geom_line() + 
    scale_color_manual(values = c("black", "grey", "orange")) + 
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("black", "grey", "orange"))
}
```

# Check rhats 
```{r}
# Check that Rhats < 1
rhats <- pomp::bake(glue("{dirs$climres}/all_rhats.rds"), dir = "", {
  bind_rows(lapply(list.files(glue("{dirs$clim_rhats}"), full.names = TRUE), readRDS)) %>%
  group_by(mod) %>%
  filter(Rhat == max(Rhat)) %>%
  mutate(Rhat = round(Rhat, digits = 1), Rhat_cond = Rhat == 1) %>%
  select(mod, Rhat_cond) %>%
  ungroup()
})

# All models converged
df_converged <- rhats %>%
  filter(Rhat_cond == TRUE)
df_converged$mod[130]
```

# Get cofficients
```{r}  
mutate(all_nasapower, mod = paste0("brmclim_", clim, "_", llid, ".rds"))

all_coefcosine <- pomp::bake(file = glue("{dirs$climres}/all_coefcosine.rds"), dir = "", {
  # Read in the coeficients 
  sapply(df_converged$mod, function(x) {
    readRDS(glue("{dirs$clim_coef}/coef_{x}"))$fixed %>%
      rownames_to_column(var = "parameter")
  }, simplify = FALSE) %>%
    bind_rows(.id = "mod") %>%
    mutate(
      # Define parameter type (int, p_cos, p_sin)
      param = case_when(str_detect(parameter, "cos") ~ "p_cos", 
                        str_detect(parameter, "sin") ~ "p_sin",
                        .default = "int")) %>%
    select(mod, param, Estimate) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = param, values_from = Estimate) %>%
    # Estimate amplitude and phase -----------------------------------------------------------------
    mutate(amp_ls = fun_amp_ls(p_cos = p_cos, p_sin = p_sin, mu = int),
           phi = fun_phi(p_cos = p_cos, p_sin = p_sin, phi_type = "week"),
           amp = fun_amp_emp(p_cos = p_cos, p_sin = p_sin, mu = int, val_return = "amp_ns"),
           mu_ns = fun_amp_emp(p_cos = p_cos, p_sin = p_sin, mu = int, val_return = "mu_ns")) %>%
    # Fix names ----------------------------------------------
    rename_with(~paste0(.x, "_mean"), .cols = c(int, p_cos, p_sin, amp_ls, amp, phi, mu_ns)) %>%
    # Add all the data from the model --------------------------------------------------------------
    left_join(mutate(all_nasapower, mod = paste0("brmclim_", clim, "_", llid, ".rds")) %>%
                distinct(study, country, llid, lon, lat, clim, mod), by = join_by(mod))
})
```

# Extract draws from the posterior for amplitude and phase =========================================
```{r}
all_samplescosine_l <- sapply(unique(all_coefcosine$clim), function(clim_i) {
  pomp::bake(file = glue("{dirs$climres}/all_samplescosine_{clim_i}.rds"), dir = "", {
  # Read in the coefficients 
  sapply(str_subset(df_converged$mod, paste0(clim_i, "_")), function(x) {
    readRDS(glue("{dirs$clim_samples}/samples_{x}")) %>%
      mutate(sam_no = row_number()) %>%
      pivot_longer(-sam_no, names_to = "parameter", values_to = "Estimate") %>%
      filter(str_detect(parameter, "sigma", negate = TRUE))
  }, simplify = FALSE) %>%
    bind_rows(.id = "mod") %>%
    mutate(
      # Define parameter type (int, p_cos, p_sin)
      param = case_when(str_detect(parameter, "cos") ~ "p_cos", 
                        str_detect(parameter, "sin") ~ "p_sin",
                        .default = "int")) %>%
    select(sam_no, mod, param, Estimate) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = param, values_from = Estimate) %>%
    # Estimate amplitude and phase -----------------------------------------------------------------  
    mutate(sam_amp_ls = fun_amp_ls(p_cos = p_cos, p_sin = p_sin, mu = int),
           sam_phi = fun_phi(p_cos = p_cos, p_sin = p_sin, phi_type = "week"),
           sam_amp = fun_amp_emp(p_cos = p_cos, p_sin = p_sin, mu = int, val_return = "amp_ns"),
           mu_ns = fun_amp_emp(p_cos = p_cos, p_sin = p_sin, mu = int, val_return = "mu_ns")) %>%
    group_by(mod) %>% 
    summarise(across(c(
      int, p_cos, p_sin, sam_amp_ls, mu_ns, sam_amp),
      list(mean = mean, median = median, q25 = ~quantile(.x, 0.25), q75 = ~quantile(.x, 0.75),
           ci95lo = ~quantile(.x, 0.025), ci95up = ~quantile(.x, 0.975), min = min, max = max),
      .names = "sam_{.col}_{.fn}"),
      sam_phi_mean = fun_phisummary(sam_phi, "phi_mean"),
      sam_phi_median = fun_phisummary(sam_phi, "phi_median"),
      sam_phi_q25 = fun_phisummary(sam_phi, "phi_q25"),
      sam_phi_q75 = fun_phisummary(sam_phi, "phi_q75"),
      sam_phi_ci95lo = fun_phisummary(sam_phi, "phi_ci95lo"),
      sam_phi_ci95up = fun_phisummary(sam_phi, "phi_ci95up"),
      sam_phi_min = fun_phisummary(sam_phi, "phi_min"),
      sam_phi_max = fun_phisummary(sam_phi, "phi_max")) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    rename_with(~str_replace_all(.x, "sam_sam_", "sam_")) %>%
    # Add mean estimates ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    left_join(distinct(all_coefcosine, mod, int_mean, p_cos_mean, p_sin_mean, 
                       amp_ls_mean, amp_mean, phi_mean, mu_ns_mean, study, country, llid, lon, lat,
                       clim), by = join_by(mod))
  })
}, simplify = FALSE)
```

# Designate to each study-country a single amplitude and phase: 
```{r}
# Each study country combination contained many locations
all_samplescosine_l$clim_t2m %>%
  filter(study == "100388") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = amp_mean)) +
  geom_histogram() + 
  facet_wrap(~country)

# Designate for the median latitude and longitude
clim_amphi <- lapply(all_samplescosine_l, function(x) {
  x %>%
  group_by(study, country) %>%
  mutate(lat_med = median(lat),
         lon_med = median(lon)) %>%
  slice_min(abs(lat - median(lat, na.rm = TRUE)), n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(clim, study, country, lat_med, lon_med, sam_phi_mean, sam_phi_ci95lo, sam_phi_ci95up,
         sam_amp_mean, sam_amp_ci95lo, sam_amp_ci95up, llid, mod) %>%
  rename_with(~str_replace_all(.x, "sam_", "clim_"), starts_with("sam_")) %>%
  rename(clim_mod = mod)
  }) %>%
  bind_rows()
```

# Compare results to immunogenicity amplitude and phase ============================================

# Read in the best models amplitude and phase 
```{r}
wbest_phisumm <- readRDS(file = glue("{dirs$modres}/wbest_phisumm.rds"))
wbest_ampsumm <- readRDS(file = glue("{dirs$modres}/wbest_ampsumm.rds"))
```

# Read in the data from the vaccinations 
# to obtain information on the regions and the no of individuals
```{r}
# Read in all the data
dat_l <- lapply(str_subset(str_subset(list.files(glue("{dirs$modfit}"), full.names = TRUE), "s08.rds"),
                           "datase", negate = TRUE), readRDS)
names(dat_l) <- sub(".*brms_(.*?)_(vl|v1|v3)_s08.*", "\\1", 
                    str_subset(str_subset(list.files(glue("{dirs$modfit}")), "s08.rds"),
                           "datase", negate = TRUE))

# Obtain information on the regions according to the best model 
dat_clu <- sapply(unique(filter(wbest_ampsumm, dat == "s08")$pat), function(x) {
  if(!is.na(filter(wbest_ampsumm, pat == x, dat == "s08")[[1, "reg"]])) {
  dat_l[[x]] %>%
      rename(clu = filter(wbest_ampsumm, pat == x, dat == "s08")[[1, "reg"]]) %>%
      mutate(reg = filter(wbest_ampsumm, pat == x, dat == "s08")[[1, "reg"]],
             clu = str_remove_all(clu, " ")) %>%
      mutate(total = n()) %>%
      group_by(study, country, reg, clu) %>%
      reframe(tot = n()/total) %>%
      distinct(study, country, reg, clu, tot)
  } else {
  dat_l[[x]] %>%
      mutate(clu = NA, reg = NA) %>%
      mutate(total = n()) %>%
      group_by(study, country, reg, clu) %>%
      reframe(tot = n()/total) %>%
      distinct(study, country, reg, clu, tot)
  }
}, simplify = FALSE) %>%
  bind_rows(.id = "pat")

# Bring the data from the regions, the amplitude and phase from the immunogenicity with that of the
# climate variables
dat_climvacc <- dat_clu %>%
  left_join(filter(wbest_ampsumm, dat == "s08"), by = join_by(pat, reg, clu)) %>%
  # Exclude the clusters not included (no mod data)
  select(pat, study, country, reg, clu, mod, mod_name, imm_name, mod_out, dat, vac, gauss, pat_tidy,
         multi, tot, sam_amp_mean, sam_amp_ci95lo, sam_amp_ci95up, sam_phi_mean, sam_phi_ci95lo,
         sam_phi_ci95up) %>%
  right_join(clim_amphi, by = join_by(study, country), relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  mutate(sam_phi_ci95lo1 = sam_phi_ci95lo,
         sam_phi_ci95up1 = case_when(sam_phi_ci95lo >= sam_phi_ci95up ~ 52,
                                     .default = sam_phi_ci95up),
         sam_phi_ci95lo2 = case_when(sam_phi_ci95lo >= sam_phi_ci95up ~ 0),
         sam_phi_ci95up2 = case_when(sam_phi_ci95lo >= sam_phi_ci95up ~ sam_phi_ci95up)) %>%
  mutate(sam_phi_ci95up1 = case_when(sam_phi_ci95lo >= sam_phi_ci95up ~ 52.5,
                                    .default = sam_phi_ci95up),
         sam_phi_ci95lo2 = case_when(sam_phi_ci95lo >= sam_phi_ci95up ~ -0.5)) %>%
  mutate(clim_phi_ci95lo1 = clim_phi_ci95lo,
         clim_phi_ci95up1 = case_when(clim_phi_ci95lo >= clim_phi_ci95up ~ 52,
                                     .default = clim_phi_ci95up),
         clim_phi_ci95lo2 = case_when(clim_phi_ci95lo >= clim_phi_ci95up ~ 0),
         clim_phi_ci95up2 = case_when(clim_phi_ci95lo >= clim_phi_ci95up ~ clim_phi_ci95up)) %>%
  mutate(clim_phi_ci95up1 = case_when(clim_phi_ci95lo >= clim_phi_ci95up ~ 52.5,
                                    .default = clim_phi_ci95up),
         clim_phi_ci95lo2 = case_when(clim_phi_ci95lo >= clim_phi_ci95up ~ -0.5)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!is.na(mod))

# Summarise dataframe so that there is only one point per region 
dat_climvaccsumm <- dat_climvacc %>%
  group_by(clim, pat, reg, clu, mod, lat_med, sam_amp_mean, sam_phi_mean) %>%
  mutate(weight_scaled = round(tot * 100)) %>%
  uncount(weight_scaled) %>%
  summarise(clim_amp_mean = median(clim_amp_mean),
            clim_phi_mean = fun_phisummary(clim_phi_mean, summ_type = "phi_median"),
            .groups = "drop")
```

# Test correlation
```{r}
dat_climvaccor <- dat_climvaccsumm
# dat_climvaccor <- dat_climvaccsumm %>%
#   filter(str_detect(mod, "csi"))

cor_l <- sapply(unique(dat_climvaccor$clim), function(x) {
  # Transform climate variable
  phi_clim <- circular::circular(filter(dat_climvaccor, clim == x)$clim_phi_mean * ((2*pi)/52), 
                             units = "radians", modulo = "2pi")
  # Transform immunogenicity variable
  phi_imm <- circular::circular(filter(dat_climvaccor, clim == x)$sam_phi_mean * ((2*pi)/52), 
                            units = "radians", modulo = "2pi")
  # Test correlation
  phi_cor <- cor.test(sin(phi_clim - mean(phi_clim)), sin(phi_imm - mean(phi_imm)))
  amp_cor <- cor.test(filter(dat_climvaccor, clim == x)$clim_amp_mean, 
                      filter(dat_climvaccor, clim == x)$sam_amp_mean)
  
  return(data.frame(
    var = c("phi", "amp"),
    cor_pers = c(phi_cor$estimate[[1]], amp_cor$estimate[[1]]),
    cor_95lo = c(phi_cor$conf.int[1], amp_cor$conf.int[1]),
    cor_95up = c(phi_cor$conf.int[2], amp_cor$conf.int[2]),
    cor_pval = c(phi_cor$p.value, amp_cor$p.value)))
}, simplify = FALSE)

bind_rows(cor_l, .id = "clim") %>%
  mutate(cor_pval = round(cor_pval, digits = 3)) %>%
  arrange(var)
```

# Test partial correlation
```{r}
rh2m <- circular::circular(filter(dat_climvaccor, clim == "clim_rh2m")$clim_phi_mean * ((2*pi)/52), 
                             units = "radians", modulo = "2pi")
t2m <- circular::circular(filter(dat_climvaccor, clim == "clim_t2m")$clim_phi_mean * ((2*pi)/52), 
                             units = "radians", modulo = "2pi")
imm <- circular::circular(filter(dat_climvaccor, clim == "clim_t2m")$sam_phi_mean * ((2*pi)/52), 
                             units = "radians", modulo = "2pi")

ppcor_l <- list()
# Correlation with relative humidity controlling for temperature
ppcor_l["rh2m|t2m_phi"] <- list(ppcor::pcor.test(imm, rh2m, t2m))
ppcor_l["rh2m|t2m_amp"] <- list(ppcor::pcor.test(
  filter(dat_climvaccor, clim == "clim_t2m")$sam_amp_mean, 
  filter(dat_climvaccor, clim == "clim_rh2m")$clim_amp_mean, 
  filter(dat_climvaccor, clim == "clim_t2m")$clim_amp_mean))
# Correlation with temperature controlling for relative humidity
ppcor_l["t2m|rh2m_phi"] <- list(ppcor::pcor.test(imm, t2m, rh2m))
ppcor_l["t2m|rh2m_amp"] <- list(ppcor::pcor.test(
  filter(dat_climvaccor, clim == "clim_t2m")$sam_amp_mean, 
  filter(dat_climvaccor, clim == "clim_t2m")$clim_amp_mean, 
  filter(dat_climvaccor, clim == "clim_rh2m")$clim_amp_mean))

bind_rows(ppcor_l, .id = "clim") %>%
  mutate(p.value = round(p.value, digits = 3)) %>%
  separate(clim, into = c("clim", "var"), sep = "_") %>%
  arrange(var)
```

# Last check of climate model fit ==================================================================
```{r}
fun_modfit <- function(llid_sel = dat_climvacc$llid[1], clim_sel = "clim_t2m") {
  cosine <- filter(all_coefcosine, llid == llid_sel, clim == clim_sel)
  pred <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$climres}/climres_pred/pred_{cosine$mod[[1]]}"))[1,]
  dat <- filter(all_nasapower, llid == llid_sel, clim == clim_sel) %>%
    mutate(pred = pred,
           modcos = cosine$p_cos_mean*cos(pi_week) + cosine$p_sin_mean*sin(pi_week),
           modcoslo = cosine$p_cos_mean*cos(pi_week) + cosine$p_sin_mean*sin(pi_week),
           modcosup = cosine$p_cos_mean*cos(pi_week) + cosine$p_sin_mean*sin(pi_week),
           )
return(dat)
}

pred_l <- sapply(unique(dat_climvacc$clim), function(x) {
   pomp::bake(glue("{dirs$climres}/all_pred_{x}.rds"), dir = "", {
     lapply(dat_climvacc$llid, fun_modfit, clim_sel = x) %>%
       bind_rows()
   }) 
}, simplify = FALSE)

pred_l$clim_cloud_amt %>%
  bind_rows(.id = "clim") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = week, y = value_norm, group = llid)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  geom_line(aes(y = pred), color = "red") + 
  geom_line(aes(y = modcos), color = "blue") +
  facet_wrap(~country, scales = "free")
```
